_comment: rerank-config.json — the -implied reranker (Phase II) signal weights as DATA, not code (harvested from trackA crosswalkConfig.json). Three layers; sub-weights sum to each layer total; the three layer totals sum to 1.0, so confidence = Σ wᵢ·sᵢ is a convex combination directly comparable across pairs. Tune here, never in code.

calibration._comment: v0 is IDENTITY (calibratedConfidence = rawScore), version-stamped 'uncalibrated-v0'. Six SPECIFIED anchors fit no curve, so honest identity beats a fabricated mapping; the write floor is enforced by the fan-out brake, not here. Real per-pair calibration is a future lever once the anchor pool grows.

fanout._comment: Gemini Risk-2 brake. confidenceFloor: drop any candidate below it. maxFanOut: keep at most this many candidates per source element (top by confidence). Both prevent a loose/vague hub from emitting a large fan-out of low-confidence edges. PROVISIONAL floor 0.45 ruled by OBSIDIAN_FLAME 2026-06-20 from the LIF->CEDS dry-run distribution (0.30 was the noise floor; 4/5 known-true pairs sit at 0.47-0.51; 0.45 keeps them, excludes the sub-0.40 noise mass, ~5254 edges). Re-derive when real calibration lands (more anchors/standards). Tunable.

predicate._comment: classifyPredicate v0 thresholds on the name+definition equivalence axis (independent of confidence). Option-set/range containment overrides to broad/narrow when present.
